phase: Authorized USB-only Arduino / ESP-IDF 4.4.7 physical comparison, followed by original boot-prefix and application restoration

controller.label: second physical SFC
controller.firmware: verified public v1.0.0, SELECT fixed to Tab

method_scope: Controller remained connected for startup comparison; no cable/orientation change requested. The successful crane_game reference concerned controller 1, whereas this comparison uses controller 2. Only selected USB code and its vendored driver were copied; this is not the original full crane application or its prior tested binary. Multiple environment and task differences change together.

backup.interpretation: This initial failure was esptool serial transport during backup, separate from subsequent USB enumeration diagnostics.

host_error_lines: E (1284) HUB: Bad transfer status 1: CHECK_SHORT_DEV_DESC
runtime.interpretation: Host initialization succeeds, but USB enumeration fails before keyboard start. Application errors=0 counts post-enumeration input errors only and does not mean Host errors=0.

restoration.scope: Restored original 64KiB boot/NVS/partition prefix byte-for-byte and original application image; not a full-chip flash snapshot or full-chip byte comparison.

interpretation: The USB-only environment matching the successful project did not reproduce enumeration success with this second controller in the present connection. A simple switch to Arduino / IDF 4.4.7 did not resolve this trial. This does not isolate a single root cause or exclude stack/timing, connection, power, electrical or controller-specific causes. No twelve-button input test was started.

final_hardware_state.fnk0099: Original SFC Host HID 1.1.0 boot prefix and application restored and verified

privacy: Selected runtime/build diagnostics only. Raw prefix dumps and their hashes, raw logs, UART port, absolute local paths, MACs and device serials remain outside Git.
next_step: Stop at comparison milestone. Choose the next physical connection or first-controller comparison before further flashing or input trials.
